definitions.explanation: Occurring or done at the same moment in time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't do two things at the same time.

examples.japanese: {同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}めましょう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's start at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: At the same time, problems also arose.

examples.japanese: {同時|どうじ}⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Simultaneous interpretation is a difficult job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こなしている→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: He is managing work and studies at the same time.

notes:
{同時|どうじ} means "the same time" or "simultaneous." Composed of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time). Functions as a noun but commonly used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the same time
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the same time as ~; while also ~
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the same time (conjunctive, connecting two events)
～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is frequently used as a conjunction meaning "at the same time as" or "while also." It can connect two simultaneous actions or add a second related point: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同時|どうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (it is convenient but at the same time also dangerous).

COMPOUNDS:
- {同時|どうじ}⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧: simultaneous interpretation
- {同時|どうじ}⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧: simultaneous progress, running in parallel
- {同時|どうじ}⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧: occurring simultaneously in multiple places
- {同時|どうじ}⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧: held at the same time
